{{Top|leg}}
'''Camo-tents''' were survival [[Tent/Legends|tents]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]]. Camo-tents were kept in the scout trooper's [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], and provided portable shelter while out in the field.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
